player_intent: The player experiences a responsive, cinematic SOCOM tactical shooter where character movement, weapon recoil, camera aim, and tactical HUD operate with zero debug clutter and complete visual scene tree clarity.
acceptance_rule: main.tscn exposes pre-authored World, Player (with CollisionShape3D, TraversalProbes, and Presentation/OperatorRig), CameraRig, and GameplayHUD instances. CharacterBody3D owns movement and collision, CameraRig owns aim intent, server weapon owns shot and damage, and all 22 integration gate test suites pass.

nodes.role: Sole owner of movement velocity, collision, and stance state.
Presentation-only wrapper containing character model, skeleton, animation, and pose pipeline.
Presents reticle, stance, health, ammo, and tactical compass without debug overlays.

must_not_change: SOCOM camera and reticle aim authority
server shot, ballistics, and damage authority
recoil bloom and composure recovery timing

system_delta.reason: Replaces legacy procedural runtime script generation with standard, inspectable, and modular Godot node hierarchies in scenes/player/operator_player.tscn and scenes/ui/gameplay_hud.tscn.

candidate.system: Node-authored Godot scene trees with Presentation sub-trees

visual_check: Open main.tscn and operator_player.tscn in Godot editor, verify node hierarchy is inspectable, press F5 to play with clean tactical HUD and identical SOCOM feel.
